why: Android Central answers this exact question with a 100W car charger list and prices, but its testing isn't shown. WIRED has a hands-on test of an Anker 100W car charger on a MacBook, but its page is about phone chargers. So two major reviewers each answer part of the question, and neither covers it fully. Everything else is niche spec comparisons, a listicle that says it tested but shows no data, off-target pages and blank results. A focused page with measured results while sharing ports could get in, but it would be up against those two famous names.
